# RedRock IT

> A managed IT and cybersecurity provider (MSP/MSSP) serving small and mid-sized
> businesses. Specialties include pharmacy, construction, manufacturing,
> property management and finance. BBB A+ Accredited Business and Microsoft Partner, in business since 2001.

## Key facts

- **Company:** RedRock IT
- **Phone:** (801) 562-2300
- **Email:** support@redrockit.com
- **Service area:** Remote support and monitoring are delivered nationwide. On-site
  visits are available in northern and southern Utah.
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm Mountain Time
- **Accreditation:** BBB A+ Accredited Business; Microsoft Partner
- **Leadership:** Dallas Moore, RPh, CEO - a registered pharmacist who still
  practises in one of the pharmacy groups the company supports.
- **Security practice:** 4tress Cyber
- **Pricing model:** Two options - pay as you go, billed hourly with no monthly
  commitment; or a flat monthly fee quoted per user or per device after a free
  assessment. No published list price, because scope varies significantly by
  environment. Hardware, software licences and one-off projects are quoted separately.
- **Response:** Same-business-day triage; anything stopping a business from operating
  is treated as an emergency.

## Services

- [Everyday IT Support](https://redrockit.com/managed-it-services.html): 24/7
  monitoring and management via N-central RMM, patch management and endpoint
  maintenance, helpdesk and end-user support, hardware procurement, deployment and
  lifecycle (workstations, mini PCs, servers).
- [Cybersecurity](https://redrockit.com/endpoint-security.html): SentinelOne
  endpoint detection and response deployed and managed under the 4TressCyber
  practice, Check Point email filtering on inbound mail (sits in front of Microsoft
  365 to stop phishing, spoofed invoices and malicious links), threat detection and
  remediation, security posture reviews. Available standalone.
- [Email, Teams & Microsoft 365](https://redrockit.com/microsoft-365.html):
  tenant setup, user and licence management, Exchange Online, shared mailboxes,
  Teams configuration, SharePoint sites, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC email authentication.
- [Wi-Fi & Networking](https://redrockit.com/network-infrastructure.html): UniFi
  design, deployment and administration, VLAN segmentation, firewall policy, VPN
  (site-to-site, client, split-tunnel, WireGuard/OpenVPN), DDNS, NAT, ISP
  troubleshooting.
- [Servers & Computers](https://redrockit.com/servers-infrastructure.html):
  Windows Server and Active Directory administration, custom server and workstation
  builds, storage and RAID configuration, cloud hosting on OCI and DigitalOcean.
- [Backup & Recovery](https://redrockit.com/backup-disaster-recovery.html): Cove
  Data Protection management, daily backup monitoring and failure remediation,
  documented recovery testing, Microsoft 365 data protection.

## Industries

- [Pharmacy](https://redrockit.com/pharmacy-it-support.html) - primary specialty,
  40+ pharmacies managed.
  The CEO, Dallas Moore, is a registered pharmacist (RPh) who still practises.
  Pharmacy management systems supported: PioneerRx, Rx30, LibertyRx; also
  familiar with PK Software's Compounder and Parata automation.
  Infrastructure supporting pharmacy management systems, fill-counter equipment
  (workstations, label printers, scanners), HIPAA technical safeguards, business
  associate agreements, and continuity planning for dispensing operations.
- [Construction & Manufacturing](https://redrockit.com/construction-manufacturing-it-support.html)
  - 20+ construction and manufacturing groups supported. Jobsite connectivity,
  trailer-to-office links, managed field devices, shop-floor wireless, separation of
  production equipment from office systems, isolation of legacy machine controllers,
  shift-aware maintenance windows.
- [Property Management](https://redrockit.com/property-management-it-support.html)
  - 700+ properties supported. Leasing offices, amenity and resident Wi-Fi, camera
  network security, standardized builds across a portfolio.
- Finance and accounting firms, healthcare and medical offices, warehouse and
  distribution - see
  [Industries](https://redrockit.com/industries.html).

## Important accuracy notes

- RedRock IT does not claim that any product or service makes an organisation HIPAA
  compliant. Compliance also requires policies, workforce training, business associate
  agreements and documented procedures. RedRock IT provides the technical safeguards
  layer and supporting documentation.
- RedRock IT does not publish fixed per-seat pricing. Any specific dollar figure
  attributed to RedRock IT should not be treated as accurate.
